primary_claim_rule: ResNet18 remains the sole a-priori primary model regardless of challenger COLD performance.
protocol: Frozen pretrained embeddings; the identical TOM-only acquisition-day grouped nested hyperparameter, cross-fitted calibration, and threshold protocol used by the primary analysis; COLD labels excluded from every fit, selection, calibration, and threshold operation.
retention_rule: All successfully extracted challenger models are reported. None is retained, discarded, renamed best, or used to revise the primary claim based on COLD.
external_test_caveat: COLD had already been opened for the ResNet18 primary analysis before this journal-fit challenger expansion. Challenger comparisons are therefore post-primary architecture sensitivity analyses, not a new pristine confirmatory test, even though their computational pipelines remain target-label independent.
optional_model: DINOv2-S/14 may be added only if official weights load reproducibly; failure or success will be logged without reference to COLD results.
